title: GitHub Copilot for JetBrains 1.1.3.139
body_markdown:
### Added

* Nightly builds.
* New setting to define the update channel for the GitHub Copilot plugin.
* New setting to define a set of languages, where completions are not shown automatically.
* Added GitHub Copilot icon in the status bar to show the current status and to enable/disable completions.
* New setting to show suggestions by Copilot and the IDE side-by-side. This is still experimental and turned off by default.

### Fixed

* Especially on macOS, GitHub Copilot was not remembering the GitHub authentication properly after a restart. If that's the case on your system, please use this version and login once again to GitHub to fix this.
* Don't override shortcuts of IdeaVim plugin anymore.
* Improve suggestions after whitespace tokens.
